objectives.description: Create test-zotero-generate-export.sh following existing test conventions
Install stub via ln -s, scratch ZOTERO_LIBRARY per test
>128KiB accumulator boundary test, asserts boundary crossed
Loud failure, no write: transport failure and malformed JSON
Stub dispatch correctness test (BBT-RPC vs items)
Run full existing test suite to confirm no regression

approaches_tried.approach: Direct path3-itemtype test without forcing API probe unreachable
approaches_tried.reason: curl-stub.sh's items-endpoint default code is 200, so probe_zotero_api() always reported reachable and Path 1 (not Path 3) ran, yielding 0 items against an empty default CURL_STUB_ZOTERO_TOTAL. Fixed by setting CURL_STUB_ZOTERO_API_CODE=000 for that scenario only.

scope_hypothesis_confirmation.note: Plan asserted 9 test cases; actual delivered count is 11 (split loud-failure into transport + malformed sub-cases, and added path3-itemtype plus pre-existing-suite as explicit scenarios). Spot-verified pre-fix-vs-post-fix divergence for the boundary-128kib case directly (not via the test file, ad hoc): running the pre-fix zotero-generate-export.sh (git rev 374fca43e, before this task's phase 2) against the same 500-item/pad=2000 stub scenario yields 0 written items (the filtered-page argv string itself already exceeds MAX_ARG_STRLEN on the very first page under this pad size, and the error-swallowing fallback returns the still-empty initial accumulator, reported as success) vs. 350 items post-fix -- confirming the regression case is real, not a test that would have passed against the unfixed script.
